source_review_notes: Main Table 1 direct MIC rows were rebuilt for the four brevibacillin entities only.
Main Table 2 and supplementary DOC synergy rows were adjudicated as FICI evidence, not direct peptide MIC values.
Only locally source-supported host toxicity values were promoted; exact unsupported non-2V CC50 database values remain source_conflict in the database layer.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The local text supports a 5-10 mg/L CC50 range for non-2V brevibacillins, but not the exact per-compound database CC50 values; the local PaddleOCR module is unavailable for bounded figure-table OCR.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Non-2V exact database CC50 rows are preserved as source_conflict instead of source_verified.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The Word DOC exposes Table 3 title and FICI values through strings fallback, but not every MIC concentration-grid cell in clean table form.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Brevibacillin Table 3 FICI rows are retained with strings locators; unsupported concentration-grid cells are not fabricated.
